arguments.description: Remove all buildings, balconies, stairs, lanterns and artificial structures. Draw one enormous unbuilt ancient woodland tree as a separate environment landmark: a gnarled chestnut trunk, branching buttress roots, twisting heavy limbs and layered asymmetrical deep-green canopy with natural gaps. Sculptural varied silhouette, not round circles. Preserve the source's deliberate native pixel clusters, material palette, shallow three-quarter game view and upper-left lighting. Transparent background.
